title: Pre-Modern Armies for Worldbuilders, Part I: Why They Fight
summary: A blog post from the acclaimed 'A Collection of Unmitigated Pedantry' examining why pre-modern armies fought, specifically designed to help worldbuilders create historically accurate fictional armies. The article analyzes the complex motivations beyond simple violence that drove ancient and medieval military forces.
problem_solved: Helps worldbuilders understand the multifaceted reasons why pre-modern soldiers fought, moving beyond simplistic portrayals of warfare.
why_valuable: Provides historically accurate context that enables creators to build more believable and nuanced fictional military organizations in their games, novels, and other creative works.
